desc: Derive the gap-based representation and prove that each operation reverses three consecutive gaps while preserving the leftmost coordinate.
Prove that arbitrary permutations are reachable within the odd-indexed gaps and within the even-indexed gaps.
Derive the weighted-sum formula for the coordinate sum and the optimal sorting/assignment rule for each parity class.
Implement the O(N log N) algorithm: compute gaps, separate by index parity, sort, pair with weights, and accumulate the answer using 64-bit integers.
Add standard input/output handling and test on the samples plus edge cases such as `N = 4`, large coordinates, and already-optimal configurations.
